details: This package is a proof-of-concept demonstrating that a published package can declare a dependency over a non-registry protocol. Its package.json declares "react" as a git dependency pointing at a gist-hosted repository (hxxps://gist[.]github[.]com/JorianWoltjer/c472f40c68122cc07b5dfc13a3359bc7[.]git), so installing it causes npm to clone and install that gist repository, which can carry its own install scripts. The package itself contains only an inert index.js exporting a string, with no lifecycle hooks, no network calls, no process execution and no access to credentials or environment values.
